answer: An agent economy coordinating walnut trade logistics can resist Sybil attacks through dynamic proof-of-work puzzles. Every new identity must solve a cryptographic challenge calibrated to the latest block pulse, filtering out an incoming tide of synthetic peers. An adversary incurs the verifiable cost of compute cycles and electrical power per spawned agent. However, this mechanism disadvantages low-power devices and lets entities with specialized hardware amass disproportionate influence.
